Weekly Product Changelog, September 23, 2026


Sorry, we missed a couple weeks of updates with people on vacation, this post covers everything since our September 4 changelog.


Desktop app 3.4.12:


⚠️ The desktop app now needs macOS 13 (Ventura) or later, and 64-bit Windows or Linux. On an older system, keep using Sunsama at[app.sunsama.com](http://app.sunsama.com/) .


- Deeplink into desktop app:


sunsama://


links now open the desktop app. sunsama://


brings Sunsama to the front, sunsama://today


opens it on today, and sunsama://action/details/<task id>


opens a specific task. This means a task link saved in Linear, Notion, or an email can open in the app instead of a browser tab. See[Linking to Sunsama](https://help.sunsama.com/docs/usage-guides/linking-to-sunsama) for how to build these links.
- When you add integrations inside the Desktop app you get redirected back to the desktop app when the connection is complete.
- The desktop app reconnects by itself after it loses the network. Previously it could get stuck on "Unable to connect" until you restarted it.
- Pressing Cmd+Shift+A (quick add) while the app was still starting could put an invisible window over the whole screen and block every click. That no longer happens.
- Updated the app to Electron 44.


Improved:


- You can now ask Sunny to summarize the work you completed over any date range, like "what did I get done last week?", and narrow it to a single channel.
- The time zone picker in Settings has a search box. It suggests your device's time zone and lists common zones first.
- Notion pages you edited today now appear in your Daily Shutdown highlights.
- In your daily highlights, get credit for commits co-authored by you.
- The Jira preview in task details shows the whole issue: formatting, priority, labels, and versions.
- The Notion panel lets you browse every database in a workspace, and tells you when it's still loading more.
- Importing a task from an integration panel removes it from the panel immediately, instead of after a two-second pause.
- Sunny's chat panel can be dragged wider, and each conversation keeps its own draft.
- Sunny's voice features only load when you open voice, so no other page touches your microphone.
- Most pages load faster, by up to most of a second.
- The Toggl integration is now called Toggl Track, to match Toggl's own naming.
- Connections to AI apps like ChatGPT and Claude stay signed in for as long as you keep using them, instead of expiring after 30 days.
- AI apps connected to Sunsama can now read, post, and edit task comments. If you use a tool allowlist, three tools have shorter names, so you may need to update the allowlist.
- The screen for approving an AI app's access to your account now says where your access is going, and warns that an app's name and logo can be faked.
- Emails you're subscribed to now have a one-click unsubscribe that works directly from your mail client.


Fixed:


- Changing your time zone could time out and leave recurring tasks on the wrong day. It now completes.
- Tasks imported from an integration panel no longer reappear in the panel a few seconds later.
- Resizing the window no longer makes the Home board jump to a different day.
- Hovering over a tall task card no longer scrolls the column out from under your cursor.
- Dragging a task no longer fails with an error if the task disappears mid-drag. On phones and tablets, a task you drag to another day is no longer cut off by the column it's moving into.
- A timer that runs past midnight keeps counting, and the time after midnight shows on the new day.
- A timer that ran for less than a minute now shows its actual span on the calendar.
- If you switch the timer to Pomodoro from the menu bar, it stays on Pomodoro instead of reverting to the stopwatch.
- Completing a task from its calendar block updates the calendar right away.
- The colored stripes and dots on calendar events now fill the whole event, instead of leaving a border of flat color.
- iCloud events that list a duration instead of an end time now appear at the right time.
- Turning off "Update due date in Todoist" now actually stops imports from changing the due date.
- Dragging a Jira issue into your task list works again for Jira accounts that have been connected for a long time.
- A broken integration preview now shows one short line instead of a large error panel.
- The "Never" section of the backlog loads again, even for tasks with duplicate ordering.
- A daily highlight no longer shows its summary twice after a reload. Daily Shutdown durations of 10 hours or more no longer wrap, and a summary that fails to load no longer spins forever.
- If you stop Sunny mid-answer and send a new message, the work Sunny had already done is no longer erased.
- Sunny no longer replies "Got it" to questions you actually wanted answered, and no longer shows a wall of red error text when Sunsama updates while your tab is open.
- Mobile: the day start and end lines follow the calendar when you pinch to zoom, and dragging a task on the mobile calendar no longer crashes the app.
- Android: home screen widgets with no data show an empty state you can tap, instead of a made-up day, and the "Add event" home screen shortcut opens instead of crashing.


Autoplan beta:


- Autoplan rules now have their own page, where you can view, edit, create, pause, and delete them. When you save a rule while chatting with Sunny, you get a link straight to it.
- Sunny now opens beside the Autoplan review with a briefing of the run. From there it can undo any change or start a fresh run.
- An Autoplan run with nothing to sort now finishes with a review instead of disappearing, and the review page no longer crashes while your day is still loading.


In-progress:


- [CalDAV calendar integration](https://sunsama.canny.io/integrations/p/caldavicloud-integration) : the beta is now open to everyone. To connect Fastmail and other CalDAV calendars, turn it on under Settings → Beta. This round also fixed events that specify a duration instead of an end time.
